items.headline: Sources: Leo Chenal to have season-ending neck surgery
items.description: Commanders linebacker Leo Chenal, who was carted off the field Sunday, will undergo season-ending neck surgery, sources confirmed to NFL Network.

items.headline: Commanders set to re-add Austin Ekeler to RB room, sources say
items.description: The Commanders are expected to sign free agent running back Austin Ekeler to their 53-man roster, pending a physical, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo.

items.headline: 2027 NFL draft order projections for Round 1, top pick, more
items.description: ESPN's Football Power Index projects the 2027 NFL draft order for Round 1, complete with each team's chances to pick in the top five, in the top 10 and at No. 1.

items.headline: Kain Medrano shines in first NFL game
items.description: John Keim discusses Kain Medrano's pick-six to help the Commanders stun the Seahawks in Week 3.
